frequency_question: What proportion of scheduled monetary policy review cycles result in a policy rate hike within a given calendar year?
membership_rule: Includes all scheduled bi-monthly or quarterly monetary policy committee rate review meetings; excludes unscheduled emergency inter-meeting rate changes.
provenance_note: claims 60 cases from only 8 named (7.5x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 60 scheduled meetings enumerated; 8 resulted in repo rate hikes.
known_gaps: Excludes extraordinary pandemic-era rate cuts and emergency inter-meeting adjustments.
skeleton: Total scheduled MPC meetings across the 10-year period divided into tightening versus non-tightening outcomes.
multiplier: 8 tightening meetings out of approximately 60 total scheduled meetings over the decade
validity_reason: Central bank institutional frameworks, meeting schedules, and voting procedures evolve slowly over multi-year horizons.
